qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (((estimate_sections es
     JOIN estimate_tasks et ON ((et.est_task_id = es.est_task_id)))
     JOIN estimates e ON ((e.estimate_id = et.estimate_id)))
     JOIN estimate_projects ep ON ((ep.est_project_id = e.est_project_id)))
  WHERE ((es.est_section_id = estimate_accessories.est_section_id) AND has_team_permission(ep.team_id, 'can_create_estimates'::text))))
